notes: Added missing stories to meet minimum and complete coverage across schema, core logic, API, tests.

change_log.value: Audit Log Schema and Contract Definition

GOV-F-004-S58.title: Audit Log Schema and Contract Definition
GOV-F-004-S58.description: Define a strict append-only audit log schema including actor (GPT/Claude/system), operation type, inputs, outputs, timestamps, trace IDs, and immutability flags. Enforce schema validation at the application and database layer.

GOV-F-004-S59.title: Audit Logging Core Service Implementation
GOV-F-004-S59.description: Build a centralized audit logging service responsible for append-only writes, automatic timestamping, trace correlation, and standardized formatting across GPT and Claude operations.

GOV-F-004-S60.title: Audit Logging API Endpoints
GOV-F-004-S60.description: Expose secure internal API endpoints for querying audit logs with filters (time range, actor, operation type) while preserving append-only guarantees and restricting mutation operations.

GOV-F-004-S61.title: Audit Logging Test Coverage
GOV-F-004-S61.description: Implement unit and integration tests validating append-only behavior, schema enforcement, correct capture of GPT/Claude operations, and prevention of update/delete actions.
